sources.label: Morphe Manager patches for apps.
sources.author: SARVO
patch_list: Spoofs the installer source so the app appears to be installed from an app store.
Forces MirAIe into night mode, enables Android Force Dark, darkens its legal WebView, and keeps energy-chart labels readable.
Disables Play Store updates by setting the version code to the maximum allowed. This patch may cause unexpected issues with some apps and does not work if the app is installed by root mounting
Hides only the Lifestyle tab from MirAIe's bottom navigation. Other tabs, icons and their order remain unchanged.
Removes the dashboard promotional carousel before it initializes.
Spoofs the package signature of the original APK.
